tools.name: provision_site
tools.description: Creates (or finds) a free Shortbread consent-banner site for a domain and returns the script tag to add before </head>, plus a claim URL the site owner uses to take over the dashboard. No account needed. Idempotent per domain. Pass the owner's email so the claim link is emailed to them.

tools.name: get_snippet
tools.description: Returns the keyless install snippet (works for any public domain with no setup) and the npm usage for React/Next.js. Use provision_site instead when you want a site key and a claim link now.

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Fetches the homepage and a few internal pages, detects the platform, the current consent banner (Cookiebot, CookieYes, OneTrust…), tracking tools, and drafts a cookie declaration. Also counts pages from the sitemap.

tools.name: compare_cookiebot_cost
tools.description: Scans the site, detects its consent tool (Cookiebot, iubenda, CookieYes, Termly, Cookie Script, Complianz, or others), maps the page count to that vendor's list tier, and returns the annual cost next to Shortbread's flat price. tools.name: check_install
tools.description: Fetches the live homepage and reports whether the Shortbread tag is present, whether a Cookiebot tag is still there, and whether the site is claimed.
